sample_findings.title: Unencrypted Telnet Enabled on Access Switch
sample_findings.description: Access switch ACC-02 allows legacy Telnet connections across management interfaces.
sample_findings.remediation: Disable 'transport input telnet' and enforce 'transport input ssh' on lines vty 0 15.

sample_findings.title: VLAN Mismatch on Inter-Switch Trunk Link
sample_findings.description: Trunk port GigabitEthernet1/0/24 permits VLANs [10, 20] on local side but peer reports [10, 20, 30].
sample_findings.remediation: Reconcile allowed VLAN lists across peer interfaces to avoid blackholing tagged traffic.
